description: This file defines a Fragment (`Camera2RawFragment`) that implements camera functionality using Android's Camera2 API. It demonstrates capturing RAW and JPEG images, handling permissions, camera setup, preview configuration, and image saving. The class manages camera states, background threads, capture sessions, image readers, and various camera controls, providing an example of advanced camera operations in an Android app.
